Local node examples:
  //Alice
  //Bob//stash
  //Charlie
  //Dave
  //Eve
  //Ferdie
  bottom drive obey lake curtain smoke basket hold race lonely fit walk

Ordinary seed settings:
  seed = 1234
  --seed 42
  rng.seed(0x123456789abc)

Documentation placeholders:
  PRIVATE_KEY=0x...
  private_key = "<your-private-key>"
  PRIVATE_KEY=0xYOUR_KEY
